declared_result.statement: The typed ActionProtocol fiber allows arbitrary nonnegative excess above unit cost on every nonidentity transition, so it does not choose relative prices or a field-source map. Under the explicitly diagnostic Cost=ActionProtocol.action identification, two admissible profiles change the same-endpoint K(9,11,13) return coefficient by the exact factor phi, and increasing one edge strictly decreases the complete fixed-memory depth-two coefficient. Separately, the constrained Book03 feedback operator has a complete mathematical P/U/z source, but identical base operator data admit complement-preserving field lifts with arbitrary real first source. The missing physical history-to-price and geometry-to-operator pullbacks remain explicit.

hypotheses.action_protocol: Only the owned axioms action(x,x)=0 and action(x,y)>=1 for x!=y are assumed; no additivity, symmetry, composition, refinement or field dependence is added.
hypotheses.finite_history_response: The K(9,11,13) depth-two result identifies Cost with ActionProtocol.action only for this diagnostic, holding the path Info and memory assignment fixed. It does not establish physical admission of either completion.
hypotheses.book03_feedback: The feedback component uses the literal constrained split Q=I-P and includes all mathematical P, U and z tangents; no physical map from the D0 state to these operators is assumed.
hypotheses.source_boundary: Equal base P,Q,U,z,F and action value can have different field derivatives under distinct complement-preserving mathematical lifts. This proves non-identifiability from the operator law alone, not physical freedom of the native programme.
hypotheses.scope_fence: No no-go for all D0, complete native price, matter Ward, physical stationarity, curved roots or GR is claimed.

declared_result.reported_state: Pinned to exact open PR #375 head 34dc2ddd6cf40803b95cf8afe66f9dd87f0bf22a. Its guards and Lean build pass. The feedback checker reports PASS_SCOPED_BOOK03_CONSTRAINED_OPERATOR_VARIATION with 20 controls; the Lean path-response result is conditional on the diagnostic cost identification. No application to native-programme-v1 or positive_gr is accepted.

A conditional relative-path Golden interferometer distinguishes the center only if controlled Q8 is admitted. The original Q8 center now has a typed map into the pre-existing Golden controlled-sign port, with an existing forward-only comparator and retained clock; this is mathematical interface evidence, not proof that Book03/G0 routes or pays for it. A later conditional model shows that identical scalar Book law and primitive price do not distinguish Q8 sheets; if complete Golden conditional Shannon output entropy is explicitly charged as the negative prospective M1 Info term, the all-negative triangle syndrome is uniquely selected modulo vertex gauge. That constitutive identification is not established: detector output entropy need not be source information. Literal fullStep still has no Q8/scene input; actual G0 admission, paid actuation, selected spin action/stress and Ward remain open.

declared_result.statement: Every continuous proper-Lorentz-conjugacy-invariant scalar Cost of one original null plaquette is constant on each full finite null 2-plane; at a smooth saturated positive minimum its Hessian vanishes on all six Lorentz generators. Independently, a C1 conjugacy-invariant scalar of one bare link has zero first J23 source at the identity, even at an interior Cost. A covariantly carried coframe/face bivector gives an algebraic J23-sensitive comparator and the retained Golden17 pretrace marker sees null amplitude, but neither comparator is selected by the compulsory physical action.

hypotheses.null_class_cost: The plaquette result assumes a continuous scalar depending only on one plaquette conjugacy class; the Hessian conclusion additionally assumes a C2 local minimum at C(I)=1 with positive-semidefinite Hessian.
hypotheses.bare_link: The zero-first-jet result assumes a C1 scalar of one bare Lorentz link invariant under all proper orthochronous conjugations.
hypotheses.oriented_escape: The bivector pairing is covariant algebraic data from a coframe/face reference; it is not a selected physical cost or paid record map.
hypotheses.scope: Excludes only scalar unmarked single-plaquette/bare-link class-price source channels. It does not exclude full Book history, coframe/observer dependence, ordered memory, the compulsory full action, matter or GR closure.

declared_result.reported_state: At pinned #334 9cd16820, both source checkers pass. The null-plane checker verifies proper-Lorentz basis dimension six, Ad scaling, trace-power blindness, the conditional PSD Ad-invariant Hessian result, a legal quartic class-Cost control and a positive Golden17 marker. The bare-link checker verifies P J23 P^-1=-J23 and the normalized coframe-bivector comparator. This excludes those scalar channels only; full physical record/action selection is open, and no GR application is accepted.

declared_result.statement: For every fixed finite Hermitian source triple J1,J2,J3 and Hermitian M, Tr(S M)=0 for every Hermitian traceless source-neutral S if and only if M belongs to span_R{I,J1,J2,J3}. The sources need not be linearly independent. This is the generic algebraic equivalence; it supplies no physical operator selection or matter/source/Ward identification.

hypotheses.finite_index: One fixed finite index type n with decidable equality; the theorem is generic in n.
hypotheses.hermitian_data: J1, J2, J3 and M are Hermitian complex matrices on n. Admissible S are all Hermitian matrices with Tr(S)=0 and Tr(S Jr)=0 for r=1,2,3.

assumes: The complete field-to-edge-price map is affine on the 24 independent original Lorentz directions.

The same original 24-direction Palatini Hessian of inertia (12,12) is the target.

assumes: The original six-plaquette Lorentz-star action and its all-40 Euler variations are fixed.
The lower-order fields are exactly the mixed-quartic and asymmetric-quartic RREF representatives pinned by the cited checkers, with their remaining homogeneous modes set to zero.
The fifth-order Lorentz exponential includes all terms through degree five.

results.statement: For every finite ordered word in one ring, the endpoint intertwining residual is the exact ordered sum of one-step residuals. The identity holds for a distinct intertwiner at each vertex and in the first-jet ring, retaining both adjacent dI terms. Supplied norm bounds give the word-value estimate; the numerical derivative estimate is proved only for a shared parameter-dependent intertwiner. Branching, comparison and physical primitive admission remain separate supplied hypotheses.

declared_result.statement: For every finite ordered word in one ring, the endpoint intertwining residual is the exact ordered sum of one-step residuals. The identity holds for a distinct intertwiner at each vertex and in the first-jet ring, retaining both adjacent dI terms. Supplied norm bounds give the word-value estimate; the numerical derivative estimate is proved only for a shared parameter-dependent intertwiner. Branching, comparison and physical primitive admission remain separate supplied hypotheses.

hypotheses.algebraic_domain: The exact identities quantify over a ring R, a finite ordered word of pairs (V,U), and an arbitrary intertwiner at each vertex. First jets are the defined noncommutative value/derivative ring Jet R.
hypotheses.supplied_norm_bounds: Value estimates require NormedRing and NormOneClass, step contractions and supplied residual bounds. The derivative estimate additionally requires nonnegative M and epsilon, supplied step/residual derivative bounds, and one shared parameter-dependent intertwiner; no derivative bound for unequal vertex intertwiners is asserted.
hypotheses.branch_and_comparison: Branched/comparison corollaries require separately supplied labels, preparations, tests and carrier/endpoint agreement propositions. No word residual proves those propositions, postselection normalization or physical primitive admission.

declared_result.reported_state: Original bounded ordered-word/jet Lean terminal submitted for CONTROL acceptance; physical instantiation remains open.

Construct a faithful semantic assertion interpretation, tie translated observations to actual native readout, and reuse existing source implication proofs with every translated premise explicit. The constructed verified-state/run map consumes the same foundation carrier. Full-native faithfulness additionally requires concrete context coverage, whose necessity is witnessed by an extra-test counterexample. Physical action, admission, source, clocks and refinement remain application obligations.

All-word commutation, common-sector faithfulness and theorem preservation are derived, not fields.

A source Lean proof of H implies P, or an indexed premise implication, is supplied and every translated premise remains proved or an explicit regime hypothesis. An arbitrary external proof calculus is not implicitly implemented.
hypotheses.additional_native_contexts: The unconditional common-sector theorem uses precisely the compiled source experiments on the full native state carrier. Only the stronger all-native equivalence requires NativeContextCoverage with a source experiment and correct readout map for each native context; the extra-test counterexample proves that this upgrade cannot be inferred without coverage.
